items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] John Burton. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, but, but. I was playing, I called Pete Fancy. So, I mean, I got to see them cats, man. I know about Eddie, you know.

ctx.x: I didn't go down there. He said, come on down, man. But I beat you, you know. Oh, I was playing at this joint. This piano player, what's his name? He's a progressive piano player, man. He had money, you know. What's his name? Not at all? No, that's crazy, guy. I had a heart to get my money, man. Oh, yeah.

Yeah, but, but. I was playing, I called Pete Fancy. So, I mean, I got to see them cats, man. I know about Eddie, you know. So, I go over there and I see Pete Fancy with a little French cap on, a little beard, man. Sitting on the bus, see. And I said, I said, Godfrey, who is? I know Godfrey. He said, where are you all playing, man? He said, across the street. So, Godfrey came over there, you know. He's playing with Pete. And the guy said, this is going to be on the table too.
